ProblemTitle: HTTP 500 error rate increase on savingsaccounts (Fixed Deposit create)
ProblemDetailsText: Failure rate increased to 100% on POST /fineract-provider/api/v1/savingsaccounts. Uncaught java.lang.NullPointerException in DepositApplicationProcessWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl.submitFDApplication while emitting FIXED_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_CREATE business event. Error surfaced via SynchronousCommandProcessingService.publishErrorEvent as HTTP 500.
